explanation: Modern processors utilize pipelining to execute multiple instructions concurrently, overlapping different stages of instruction processing.  Understanding pipelining is crucial for performance optimization because it allows for significant speed improvements, but also introduces hazards (data, control, structural) that can limit performance if not carefully managed. Optimizing code for pipelined processors involves minimizing these hazards and maximizing instruction-level parallelism.
